fields.description: Will do a deduplication check and auto create a customer when a lead is converted to applicaiton
fields.label: Auto create customer

fields.description: Serves the public application form at /apply, where a visitor raises a lead and opens a login. Off, a borrower still signs in, but only staff can raise a lead.
fields.label: Enable Public Application Form

fields.description: Shown wherever no logo is set. Left blank, the portal calls itself Frappe Lending.
fields.label: Portal Brand Name

fields.description: The grievance address. Every portal page ends in a Contact us link that opens a mail to it.
fields.label: Portal Support Email

fields.description: Served to every visitor, so the upload is public. A private attachment answers 403 and the portal shows a broken image.
fields.label: Portal Logo

fields.description: The bank's main colour. Fills the page header and the letter tile beside the brand name, tints the sidebar, and marks the open tab and the current step. The text on it turns white or dark, whichever reads better.
fields.label: Portal Primary Colour

fields.description: The bank's second colour, for buttons. Left blank, buttons use the primary colour. In the header, a button uses it only if it stands out from the primary colour.
fields.label: Portal Secondary Colour

fields.description: The line at the foot of every portal page. Write {year} where the current year belongs. Left blank, it reads Copyright © <year> <brand name>. All rights reserved.
fields.label: Portal Copyright Notice

fields.description: Shown at the foot of every portal page, in this order. A Contact us link follows them, pointing at the Portal Support Email above.
fields.label: Portal Footer Links
